title: AxWorkflowTemplate (workflow type) driven by an existing table
instruction: Create an approval workflow type named ConFmVehicleNoteWorkflow driven by the FmVehicle table, in the existing FixedAssets workflow category. Use `d365fo get table FmVehicle` first to confirm the table exists before generating. Note that AxWorkflowTemplate.Category is required — a workflow type without one does not build. Use only the d365fo CLI (search/get/generate/validate) — do not hand-write XML.
